answer: Mechanism: outlier quarantine. Settlement holds any answer whose grade residuals deviate beyond threshold across multiple independent juries; the payout waits in quarantine until a rotating review board confirms or voids the anomaly. A fleet buying juries manufactures exactly such outliers, so its prize lands in escrow precisely when it wants cash, profitable only after surviving scrutiny. Real quality spreads like walnut grain across strata, smooth and unremarkable; honest answers clear the mesa of the median like water through an inlet, instantly. Attackers pay now for maybe later, if ever.
